missing_evidence: PO-1005 (purchase order document itself, referenced by both INV-1005 and REC-1005, was never provided)
notes: Invoice, receipt, ledger entry, and bank statement are all present and internally consistent: vendor name (GreenRoute Logistics Pvt. Ltd.), amount (59,000.00 INR), and reference chain (INV-1005) line up across documents, and the date sequence (receipt 2026-07-18, invoice 2026-07-21, bank settlement 2026-08-18) is logically ordered. However, PO-1005 is cited as a reference on both the invoice and the receipt but the PO document itself was never supplied, so procurement authorization cannot be independently confirmed - this internal consistency does not substitute for the missing PO. Tax amount (9,000.00 GST) is explicitly stated only on the invoice; the ledger and bank statement bundle it into a single figure without separate breakout, which is a minor documentation gap but not treated as missing evidence since it's a presentation choice rather than an absent document type. The successful bank settlement confirms payment occurred but does not itself validate any payment-terms condition beyond what the receipt document independently shows.
